Tarikh | Episode 1066 | 19 September 2025
This episode explores the dual nature of the handshake as a symbol of trust and betrayal.
# Betrayal of Trust: It begins with the iconic betrayal of Julius Caesar by his friend Brutus, represented by the line "Et tu, Brute?"
# Historical Deceptions: The episode highlights several historical betrayals, including Mir Sadiq's deceit that led to Tipu Sultan's defeat and Neville Chamberlain's appeasement of Hitler at Munich.
